summary_md: **Sthānika AI ([@sthanikaai](https://x.com/sthanikaai/status/2116108922893615493))** reports **Sieve-31B-v3** scoring 68.3 on held-out versions of trained skills and a higher 75.3 on never-seen domains in the Jev Decision Index private sets; Apache-2.0 open weights ([sthanika-ai on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/sthanika-ai)).
relevance: A ~30B open model claiming strong out-of-domain generalization, a good DGX Spark candidate.

media.description: Score card: 68.3 on trained-skill held-out sets vs 75.3 on unseen domains.
